name: Soft-Baked Vanilla Sugar Cookies
whyItWorks: Tender, soft-baked sugar cookies made with refined flour and vanilla have a pillowy texture that crumbles and breaks down rapidly without crunchy edges. They are free from nuts, seeds, and chocolate.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose plain soft sugar cookies without excessive colored sprinkles or thick fatty frostings during flare periods.
watchOuts: Limit portion to 1–2 cookies to avoid high refined sugar spikes.
